name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 21 – Am 87
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 21a. Calls for the multiannual financial framework 2028-2034 to provide for a level of allocations commensurate with that of the 2021-2027 MFF, i.e. at least 65 % of the total budget and EUR 1.162 billion.
